text:
Carmen: Quick sync — prototyping a "amortized session cost" card for the console. Idea: show per-session token burn + cache/prefetch savings and an 'amortized unit cost' so teams can compare Hosted vs Dedicated. Thoughts on telemetry and quota implications? cc @Liam @Suresh

Liam: Love the idea. two quick asks: (1) make it explicit that numbers are estimates, (2) show sampling rate used. sampling bias will confuse PMs if not visible.

Suresh: How are we computing "amortized"? we have per-invocation token traces, but not session aggregation. naive on-the-fly will be expensive.

Fahim: yep — aggregating sessions in realtime is bad. propose hourly batch job that pre-aggregates session metrics and writes to telemetry store with TTL. tag prefetch hits so we can attribute them properly.

Suresh: example heuristic I was thinking: session_cost = sum(inv_token_costs) - prefetch_credit_allocated. For multi-model chains, credit goes to first model that requested the prefetch. small snippet:
```sql
-- pseudo
SELECT session_id, SUM(tokens) AS raw_tokens, SUM(prefetch_saved_tokens) AS prefetch, SUM(model_cost) AS model_cost
FROM invocation_traces
GROUP BY session_id;
```

Maria: UX notes: always surface an "estimated" badge. include tooltip that shows formula and sampling rate. add a toggle to show/hide cache savings so teams can see raw vs amortized. Also need states: empty, stale, reconciled.

Diego: Billing perspective: prefer separate line item for "prefetch credit" on invoice rather than subtracting negative cost from sessions — it's clearer. Also important: quota enforcement should be based on raw tokens consumed, not amortized view, otherwise users will be surprised.

Carmen: So two design options: (A) show single amortized line (may mask raw usage), (B) show raw + prefetch credit as separate rows and an optional rolled-up amortized metric. I'm leaning B.

Liam: B feels safer. and we should surface both "as-served" (what actually happened with current routing/sticky pins) and an "as-if" column (what cost would be under a pinned/dedicated routing model) so teams can simulate migrations.

Suresh: Edge case: canary/circuit fallback flows. If a request falls back to a cheaper model, attribution changes. we need to record route metadata so reprojections are possible.

Fahim: infra notes: batch pre-agg + incremental update. add a flag to skip very high-cardinality sessions that skew means. store median + p90 rather than only mean. sampling config will be set per-tenant.

Maria: UX mockup summary (text): card shows header "Session economics (est.)". left column = raw tokens / raw cost, middle = prefetch savings, right = amortized cost. hover shows formula + link to docs. subtle color for estimated values.

Diego: Also: for invoice mapping, I'll draft language that maps console rows to invoice components. Important: if prefetch runs on Dedicated nodes, invoice treatment may differ (reserved capacity vs usage). I'll flag billing@legal.

Carmen: Quotas: Proposal — quotas continue to use raw token counts and documented exceptions for prefetch. we show "quota impact" on card but don't change enforcement. anyone object?

Liam: no objection. keep enforcement simple.

Suresh: one more — multi-model chains: we need a deterministic attribution order (first-hop wins) and tie-breaker by cost weight if first-hop is a proxy. document that in telemetry schema.

Fahim: implementation checklist (short):
- telemetry: add session_agg job + prefetch tags
- infra: disk store for hourlies, eviction policy
- api: new /telemetry/sessions endpoint (paged)
- ui: card + toggle + tooltip
- billing: invoice mapping doc
- sampling: tenant-level sampling flag

Carmen: Nice. last point — routing UX: if we expose an "as-if" simulation, we need to recompute amortized numbers on the fly from aggregated traces (ok if slightly slower). is that acceptable?

Liam: yes if it's best-effort and marked estimated. maybe precompute common "as-if" scenarios (dedicated vs hosted) for top customers.

costbot: Cost anomaly detected for tenant "bluebird": session 9d2f... spike ~3x baseline; suggested mitigation: throttle prefetch=on for that tenant.

Diego: noted. I'll open a billing incident if that affects invoicing.

Carmen: Great work. I'll create a checklist PR linking infra + telemetry + ui mock. Will also loop in legal for invoice wording. Thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
